# Meridian 1.1.0
World clocks, full dates and local weather on your Mac desktop and menu bar.
- Universal application for Apple Silicon and Intel; requires macOS 14 or later. - Full year, month, day and weekday for every clock, including previous/next-day labels. - Choose one or more desktop and menu bar clocks independently; up to six regions. - Local weather from Open-Meteo, with unavailable and outdated states. - New orbital-clock app icon, also shown in the menu bar. - Fixed dropdown clipping and offsets; all clocks remain accessible on smaller displays. - English by default, with live Simplified Chinese switching. - Sparkle automatic update checks, optional background downloads and Ed25519-signed archives.
## Download
Download **Meridian-1.1.0-macOS.zip**, unzip it and move **Meridian.app** to Applications. `SHA256SUMS` contains the archive checksum. `appcast.xml` is the signed update feed used by the app.
This first release uses ad-hoc Apple code signing and is **not notarized**. macOS may block first launch under its security policy. Sparkle's archive signature authenticates updates; it is separate from Apple notarization.

## 简体中文
Mac 多时区桌面与状态栏时钟，每个地区显示完整年月日、星期、时间和天气。可分别选择桌面、状态栏显示一个或多个时钟；默认英文，可即时切换中文。已修复下拉面板裁切，加入全新应用图标及签名自动更新。
下载 ZIP 后将 Meridian.app 移到“应用程序”。此首版尚未经过 Apple 公证，首次打开可能受 macOS 安全策略限制。**仅限非商业使用**，授权以随包 LICENSE 为准。
